reviews.title: Downgraded again
reviews.text: The positive with this app over some others is the ability to click on just military, for instance. Others need more actions for the same detail. The negatives are building however. Now there’s a ‘new improved’ pop up blob on the lower left of the screen appearing if I happen to touch anything but an aircraft for more info. Didn’t do that before - or it seemed far less intrusive at least. If there was a settings option I’d hide that. Also, as has been the case for a few years, Flight Radar 24 (as an example) has far more aircraft identified than this. To be honest, a big reason I stuck with this app is the reduced legacy rate and the assumption that if I ended subs and re-applied at a later date, the annual/monthly cost might likely be higher.

reviews.title: SCAM WARNING: They removed Lifetime Access for existing users!
reviews.text:
I previously purchased the Lifetime Premium version on their old app. However, the developers shut down that app, launched this "new" version with the exact same functionality, and stripped away my Lifetime status just to force a recurring subscription.

I have contacted support multiple times regarding my legitimate Lifetime access, but they are ignoring my emails and avoiding responsibility. This is dishonest and a clear violation of user trust. Restore legacy Lifetime accounts immediately!

reviews.title: Update on the downward spiral of this app
reviews.text: It’s been nearly a year now with planes being in the air with no logos. I was told they were stripping flight logos from airlines operated as franchises so the paper company logos would apparently start appearing instead of the logos for the actual airlines people are buying tickets from and indeed the liveries. So Aer lingus regional flights will have emerald airlines logos, air Canada express will have jazz logos. These are companies no one even knows about so what’s the point?? It’s like Pepsi or Coca Cola removing their branding and replacing it with the logo of the bottling company. It seems they are doubling down on the misinformation. We now have Air Canada flights operating in to London Heathrow with Air Canada Rouge flight logos. An airline that doesn’t even operate to Heathrow let alone have the livery on the side of the plane. I will never know why the staff maintaining the app have nuked the accuracy of their app. The fact they are currently advertising their app to people to check what flight is in the sky is just laughable. Chances are they will completely mislead you.
